hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central America, bordering both the Caribbean Sea and the North Pacific Ocean, between Costa Rica and Honduras || extensive Atlantic coastal plains rising to central interior mountains; narrow Pacific coastal plain interrupted by volcanoes || largest country in Central America; contains the largest freshwater body in Central America, Lago de Nicaragua || Resources: gold, silver, copper, tungsten, lead, zinc, timber, fish || Exports: garments, gold, insulated wire, coffee, beef (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: extensive Atlantic coastal plains rising to central interior mountains; narrow Pacific coastal plain interrupted by volcanoes || Central America, bordering both the Caribbean Sea and the North Pacific Ocean, between Costa Rica and Honduras

climate.excerpt: tropical in lowlands, cooler in highlands || destructive earthquakes; volcanoes; landslides; extremely susceptible to hurricanes volcanism: significant volcanic activity; Cerro Negro (728 m) is one of Nicaragua's most active volcanoes; its lava flows and ash have been known to cause significant damage to farmland and buildings; other historically active volcanoes include Concepcion, Cosiguina, Las Pilas, Masaya, Momotombo, San Cristobal, and Telica

economy.excerpt: low-income Central American economy; until 2018, nearly 20 years of sustained GDP growth; recent struggles due to COVID-19, political instability, and hurricanes; significant remittances; increasing poverty and food scarcity since 2005; sanctions limit investment || Exports: garments, gold, insulated wire, coffee, beef (2023) || Industries: food processing, chemicals, machinery and metal products, knit and woven apparel, petroleum refining and distribution, beverages, footwear, wood, electric wire harness manufacturing, mining
